planned_arguments.prompt:
Use case: ads-marketing. Produce ONE finished flat opaque landscape poster for neighborhood digital screens, width:height 16:9. Cinematic photographic space plus a crisp editorial notice, approachable adult cultural event. 요청한 화면 비율을 유지하면서 현재 도구와 모델이 지원하는 가능한 최대 해상도로 출력.

Whole design, using a 1280×720 design grid as proportional layout guidance, not a fixed output pixel request: full-height photographic scene occupies x=0–832; a pale warm-white vertical notice occupies x=832–1280. Hard clean vertical boundary, with no people, bridge beams or screen glare entering the notice. Notice has approximately 40px side margins, dark charcoal text and generous vertical grouping.

Scene: a riverside path under a real concrete bridge at blue-gray evening, photographed from rear-left at seated audience eye level. Bridge underside recedes into coherent depth above a supported luminous fabric cinema screen deeper in the scene, below the title clearing. The left crop continues the water and path out of frame. Six anonymous adult neighbors in winter jackets sit on six separate modest individual mats, clearly grounded with natural contact shadows, facing the screen. One adult speaker stands at the side of the screen facing the audience, visibly holding exactly one handheld microphone: a clearly connected hand, forearm, and microphone grip close to their mouth. Two visible upright screen supports and feet contact the path. Screen displays a simple atmospheric short-film landscape still without words or symbols. Soft white screen light and restrained motivated amber bridge/path lighting illuminate the gathering. Concrete, fabric, river reflections, coat folds and mat edges feel naturally photographic. Keep welcoming visual warmth and enough ambient detail to recognize the outdoor location; no horror darkness.

Image/type relationship: reserve a quiet dark upper-left scene clearing. Large white humanist sans Korean title, one line around 62 design px; English beneath around 29px; descriptor beneath around 32px. All three left aligned at x≈54 and comfortably clear of bridge edges and screen. Title leads to the luminous screening/gathering; the right date/time then directs participation. Screen and adults occupy the middle/lower scene, not the title clearing.

Exact printed copy, each line exactly once. Print ONLY these ten entries, keeping Korean word spaces, English case, digits, and punctuation. Each entry stays on one line; no fixed line break is required. No labels from this spec should be printed.
Upper-left scene identity, in this order:
"다리 아래 영화관"
"BRIDGE CINEMA"
"야외 단편 상영 · 감독과의 대화"
Right notice, schedule group at upper-right: date around 42px, time around 44px, venue around 36px:
"2026.12.05 토요일"
"18:00–20:30"
"홍제천 연가교 아래"
Right notice, participation group after a generous gap, around 32px with full usable column width:
"17:30부터 입장"
"무료 관람 · 선착순 80명"
Right notice, preparation/contingency group in the lower column, around 32px:
"돗자리 지참"
"우천 시 실내로 변경"

Finish and reading constraints: every practical fact must remain readable when the entire poster is displayed at 720×405. Protect strong contrast and generous Korean counters and word gaps; keep colon dots separate, the range dash visibly longer than a hyphen, and the middle dots distinct with visible adjacent word spacing. Notice uses the full height as grouped information rather than a bottom strip. Crisp consistent Korean/English raster lettering without scene grain on the letters. If a group needs room, reduce scene or title/frame size before squeezing facts. Keep photographic perspective, limb ownership, screen supports, mat contact, and light direction coherent. Single image, no border mockup, no contact sheet, no inset alternate poster. No added copy, credits, logos, signage, pseudo-print, QR code, or watermark. No decorative tape required.

planned_arguments_digest_method: UTF-8 canonical JSON, sorted keys, no extra whitespace
maintained_features: Assigned cinematic photographic scene at left and full-height pale notice at right
Supported screen, seated adults on individual mats, one speaker holding one microphone
Ten literal entries once and 16:9 opaque flat poster
